Details: Train the subscription prediction model using Stage1_Train and predict subscription probability for each customer in Stage1_Test.
Rank the 100 Stage1_Test customers by predicted_probability and take the 10 highest-probability customers.
If two or more customers have identical predicted probabilities, use customer_id in ascending alphanumeric order.
Select exactly 6 customers from the top 10 while maximizing expected net value and satisfying budget and capacity constraints.
N = 10 candidates; K = 6 (SUM(x_i) = 6); budget C = 25 (total contact_cost <= 25); capacity H = 22 (total capacity_units <= 22).
Estimate the probability that at least 50% of the selected six customers subscribe.
At least 3 of the 6 customers subscribe.
No optimal Stage 2 customer list or solved Stage 3 result is included.
